items.title: 全球債市遭拋售 美、日、德、英、澳債券殖利率齊創多年高點
paras: 周二(9/1)隨著國際油價上漲加劇市場對全球進入結構性通膨的擔憂，以及投資人對聯準會(Fed)升息預期升高，全球債券殖利率攀升至近20年來的最高水平。彭博全球政府債券殖利率指數周一連續第四天上漲，升至3.72%，為2008年年中以來的最高水平。10年期美債殖利率升至2025年1月以來最高水平，日本、德國、英國、澳洲債券殖利率也均觸及多年來最高水平。
推動殖利率走高的最新催化劑被認為是聯準會主席華許上週在傑克森霍爾的演講。華許演講的「鷹派」程度超乎預期，令聯準會9月升息預期大幅提高。目前交易員預計，聯準會9月升息的機率已經超過50%，市場也提高了對今年進一步緊縮貨幣政策的押注。
摩根大通資產管理公司亞太區首席市場策略師Tai Hui表示，美國和日本國債殖利率上升，反映全球投資人對通膨和財政前景的雙重擔憂。週二，布蘭特原油價格上漲2%，至每桶92美元以上，歐洲天然氣價格則處於3月以來最高水平。「中東僵局有可能進一步推高能源價格。同時，美日幾乎沒有採取任何行動來解決財政赤字問題。」他稱，因此，投資人尋求更大的利差或期限溢價，才願意持有這些經濟體的長期政府債券。
First Eagle Investments投資組合經理兼高級研究分析師Idanna Appio稱：「市場正在為美國乃至全球的短期利率重新定價。投資人開始重新評估中性利率水平在哪裡，而且這些利率本身也已逐步上升。」
單就美債市場而言，在美國債務負擔已超過40兆美元的環境下，大型科技公司又大舉發行債券，為AI熱潮籌集資金，加劇最近幾週的美債拋售，進一步推高10年期美債殖利率。週二，10年期美債殖利率漲破市場頗為重視的4.75%關口，升至4.792%，創下19個月新高。這關口被視為5%大關前的一道關鍵堡壘。
景順亞太區全球市場策略師趙耀庭表示，美債殖利率若在較長時間內維持高位，可能引發階段性市場波動。久期較長的資產對殖利率變化仍然極為敏感，若債券殖利率繼續上升，股票估值也可能面臨一定壓力。
不過，華許上周的演講也再度強調，美國經濟仍展現顯著韌性。這穩健的經濟背景仍對風險資產構成支撐。他稱，繼續看好與AI、數位基礎建設等結構性成長主題相關的市場領域；在固定收益資產投資方面則保持選擇性，尤其關注各類久期債券風險。
財富管理機構Dakota Wealth Management高級投資組合經理Robert Pavlik強調，4.75%是一個「足以讓人們真正開始警覺」的關鍵心理關口。他補充稱，一旦殖利率向5%大關逼近，市場對美股迎來深度回調的擔憂便會迅速蔓延。
10年期日本政府債券殖利率周二也自1996年以來首次攀升至3%。分析認為，這既是全球債券拋售潮的一環，也反映出美國財政部長對日本升息的公開施壓，以及市場對日本央行9月政策行動的高度預期。
據報導，美國財長貝森特日前在G20財長會議期間，分別會見日本財務大臣片山皋月和日本央行行長植田和男。貝森特明確告知雙方，日本下一步應當升息。貝森特稱：「我掌握市場所不知道的資訊，我相信日本政府和日本央行將採取行動，推動日元走強。」這是迄今為止美國就日本貨幣政策發出的最明確信號。
周二，10年期德國國債殖利率達到3.364%，為2011年以來未見的水平。10年期澳洲債券殖利率也飆升至2011年以來的水平。10年期英國國債殖利率升至5.254%，為2008年以來最高水平。
道明證券駐新加坡亞太區高級利率策略師Prashant Newnaha表示，「債券市場沒有內爆，但它發出了一個非常明確的信號，即更高的通膨意味著各國在更長時間內維持更高利率水平，已經是市場的最低底線了。」
他補充，「長期以來，日本國債與美債一樣，也一直是全球固定收益資產的支柱。現在它已然翻轉。日債殖利率進一步上升，可能會推動投資人逐步重新配置日本資產。」

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美軍再轟伊朗 油價飆 全球債市遭拋售 道瓊跌逾400點 費半摔逾2%
paras: 美國對伊朗發動新一輪空襲，市場擔憂荷姆茲海峽運輸進一步受阻，國際油價應聲大漲。能源價格攀升加劇通膨疑慮，也推高聯準會 (Fed) 9 月升息預期，美股週二 (1 日) 全面收黑，道瓊終場收跌逾 400 點，那斯達克指數跌逾 1%，費城半導體指數重挫超過 2%。
西德州原油期貨週二上漲 5.9%，報每桶 90.82 美元，布蘭特原油盤中一度突破每桶 95 美元。美國中央司令部表示，美軍已對伊朗目標發動新一輪攻擊，象徵中東戰事再度升高。
美國總統川普表示，美軍空襲是為了報復伊朗企圖在荷姆茲海峽布雷，以及先前對約旦美軍基地發動攻擊。他警告，如果德黑蘭採取反擊，美方還將發動更多攻勢。
最新一輪衝突打破美伊數週來的短暫平靜。川普政府先前一度表示，將由軍事行動轉向經濟手段向伊朗施壓，但雙方在臨時和平協議破局後，均未展現重啟談判的明顯意願。
油價大漲帶動全球公債殖利率升至 2008 年以來高點。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4 個基點至 4.79%，盤中觸及 2025 年 1 月以來最高；30 年期公債殖利率升至 5.27%附近，徘徊在數十年高點。英國 10 年期公債殖利率大升 16 個基點至 5.22%，德國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 2 個基點至 3.34%。
美股週二 (1 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 上漲 1.08%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 2.61%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.28%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 1.24%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.87%。
費城半導體族群多低迷。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 2.36%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 0.18%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 1.51%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 3.61%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 2.27%。
記憶體類股盡墨。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 2.64%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 小跌 0.02%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 1.90%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 1.42%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 2.31%。
台股 ADR 漲跌不一。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 0.32%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.30%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 2.97%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 小漲 0.07%。
企業新聞
伺服器製造商戴爾 (DELL-US) 週二受到大盤走弱、AI 概念股賣壓及財報前獲利了結影響，股價重挫近 7%，收在每股 425.00 美元。不過，戴爾盤後公布的財報與財測全面優於市場預期，激勵股價盤後大漲逾 9%。
戴爾將 2027 會計年度 AI 伺服器營收預估由 600 億美元大幅上調至 740 億美元，並將全年營收財測提高 250 億美元至 1,920 億美元；全年調整後每股盈餘預估也從 17.90 美元上修至 25.50 美元。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 下滑 1.51% 至每股 217.44 美元。市場擔心，輝達一方面投資 Anthropic，另一方面又參與雲端服務商 Lambda 規模達 350 億美元的運算合作，可能形成資金在相關企業之間循環流動的「循環融資」。不過，輝達管理層在最近一次財報電話會議中，否認這項說法適用於公司運用資產負債表的方式。
特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 挫跌 3.22% 至每股 356.09 美元。儘管投資人期待 Cybercab 有機會加入特斯拉自駕計程車車隊，仍未能阻止股價走弱。
蘋果(AAPL-US)週二迎來特納斯 (John Ternus) 正式擔任執行長後的首個交易日，股價勁揚近 3% 至每股 325.13 美元，特納斯向員工強調，公司擁有強勁的產品布局，並預告下週將舉行一場「精彩」的 iPhone 發表會。
Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) 收黑 1.24%，收在 103.51 美元，即使摩根士丹利將其投資評等調升至「優於大盤」，並把目標價由 124 美元上修至 150 美元，仍未能帶動股價走高。
獲比爾蓋茲支持的地熱能源公司 Fervo Energy (FRVO-US) 飆漲 28.41% 至每股 19.75 美元，主因公司與 Alphabet 旗下 Google 簽訂供電協議。不過，自 5 月 13 日掛牌交易以來，Fervo股價仍累計下跌約 46%。
經濟數據
美國週二公布的數據顯示，7月職位空缺數小幅增加，自6月的4.3%升至4.4%，就業市場大致保持穩定；美國製造業活動則連續第8個月擴張，但成長速度略為放緩。市場接下來將聚焦週五公布的8月非農就業報告。
華爾街分析
9 月向來是美股歷史表現較差的月份。在油價、通膨與殖利率同步升高之際，季節性壓力進一步加重市場的避險情緒。
Baird 投資策略師 Ross Mayfield 表示，債市大幅且劇烈波動時，股市向來需要時間消化，相關壓力短期內仍可能持續。
不過，Mayfield 認為，目前經濟數據尚未出現足以支持 Fed 9 月升息的明顯變化。他預估 Fed 本月仍將維持利率不變，但今年底前可能至少升息一次。他也提醒，距離會議召開仍有變數，尤其市場正等待週五公布的 8 月非農就業報告。
Forex.com 分析師 Fawad Razaqzada 認為，油價上漲可能重新點燃通膨壓力，提高貨幣政策進一步收緊的風險；與此同時，全球債券殖利率持續攀升，也加重投資人的不安情緒。
Evercore ISI策略師Krishna Guha 指出，Fed 主席華許將密切關注油價上漲對通膨預期及債券殖利率的影響。殖利率持續攀升，可能迫使華許要求經濟數據釋出更明確的降溫訊號，才有理由在9月暫緩升息。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)

items.title: 貝森特：荷姆茲2年內將被「繞過」、對石油業「毫無價值」
paras: 美國財長貝森特週二 (1日) 預測，隨著中東國家加速興建陸上輸油管線，荷姆茲海峽在全球石油運輸中的角色將於兩年內被「繞過」，屆時可能淪為對石油產業「毫無價值的一片水域」。
貝森特在北卡羅來納州出席二十國集團 (G20) 財長峰會期間接受福斯財經網訪問時表示，荷姆茲海峽對許多國家仍是石油運輸瓶頸，但對美國而言已非關鍵要道。他預估，兩年後大量原油將改由陸上管線運輸，降低全球對這條海峽的依賴。
美國對荷姆茲海峽依賴降至低點
美國能源資訊署 (EIA) 資料顯示，2024年美國每天經由荷姆茲海峽，從波斯灣國家進口約50萬桶原油，僅占美國原油進口總量的7%。
隨著美國國內原油產量提高，以及從加拿大進口的原油增加，美國自波斯灣國家採購的原油已降至近40年最低，荷姆茲海峽一旦受阻，對美國能源供應的直接衝擊也相對有限。
不過，這條水道對全球石油市場仍相當重要。國際能源署 (IEA) 統計顯示，2025年全球約34%的原油經由荷姆茲海峽運輸，其中大部分流向亞洲國家。
中東國家加速建造替代輸油管線
沙烏地阿拉伯與阿拉伯聯合大公國目前已有可繞過荷姆茲海峽的輸油管線。沙烏地阿拉伯、阿聯、伊拉克與土耳其等國也已達成協議，計劃興建更多陸上管線，降低石油出口對海峽的依賴。
貝森特認為，這些替代路線啟用後，荷姆茲海峽在石油貿易中的角色將迅速下降。
不過，部分新管線可能需要數年才能完工，意味這條海峽短期內仍將是全球能源運輸的重要通道。
戰爭限制航運 國際油價升破95美元
伊朗軍方在持續超過6個月的戰爭期間限制船隻通行荷姆茲海峽，拖慢航運並推高國際油價。
布蘭特原油週三美東時間下午3時30分報每桶95美元以上，明顯高於美國與以色列2月底對伊朗開戰前一天的72.48美元。
美國汽油價格也同步上漲。根據美國汽車協會 (AAA) 統計，全美普通汽油平均價格週二升至每加侖4.09美元；衝突爆發前兩天，平均價格僅為2.98美元。
美財政部擴大制裁
近幾個月來，美軍持續強化在荷姆茲海峽的部署，包括引導油輪經由靠近阿曼海岸的南部航道通行，並對伊朗港口實施長達數月的封鎖。
這些行動是川普政府對伊朗施加經濟壓力的一部分。美國財政部上週制裁近60個被指協助伊朗政府的實體、個人與船隻，並警告其他國家切斷與伊朗的金融往來，否則可能遭排除在美元體系之外。
貝森特表示，美國對違反制裁的行為將採取「零容忍」立場，並稱川普政府的經濟施壓行動已獲得其他國家大力支持。美方將繼續切斷伊朗的資金與金融管道，對其政權施加更大壓力。
伊朗里亞爾8月跌破200萬里亞爾兌1美元，創歷史新低，7月年通膨率更升至66%。面對匯率與物價雙重壓力，伊朗央行準備向外匯市場注入最高20億美元，以平抑里亞爾劇烈波動。
伊朗央行總裁Abdolnaser Hemmati週二表示，伊朗擁有充足外匯準備，央行也持續收回外匯應收款項。他更直接向美國喊話，強調伊朗持有足夠外匯，國家不會崩潰，相關說法只是心理戰。

items.title: AI資料中心蓋太多？知名投資人反駁：蓋不夠才是問題！500億美元算力 10個月就能回本
items.title_en: Are AI Data Centers Being Overbuilt? Prominent Investor Counters: The Real Issue Is Underbuilding! $50 Billion of Compute Can Pay Back in 10 Months
paras: 知名投資人、Atreides Management創辦人兼首席投資長Gavin Baker近日對AI基礎設施前景提出截然不同的看法。他認為, 市場目前最擔心的AI資料中心「過度建設」可能並非真正風險, 更值得警惕的反而是算力供給不足。Baker指出, 全球約有15億名知識工作者, 但目前真正大量使用AI的用戶仍只是其中極小一部分, 一旦AI進一步普及, 算力需求可能遠超現有供給。
Baker在8月31日播出的a16z Podcast中表示, AI需求的擴散才剛剛開始, 而電力、晶片、銅、資料中心施工及政府審批等多項供應鏈限制, 正共同壓制算力新增速度。他甚至認為, 如果供給長期無法追上需求, AI服務價格未必會像市場普遍預期般持續下降, 反而可能出現「算力不平等」, 讓大型企業及資金雄厚的使用者優先取得最先進的AI能力。
Baker以Atreides自身使用情況作為需求快速升溫的例子。他透露, 公司內部Token消耗量從3月到8月已增加100倍, 而團隊近期取得Grok Enterprise使用權後, 僅兩名員工使用就可能讓一個月的Token支出再增加10至20倍。Baker強調, 這並非浪費性支出, 而是因為AI逐漸被嵌入投資研究及其他知識型工作, 實際產生了更高的使用需求。
a16z合夥人David George則指出, 目前AI產業的收入主要仍由不到1,000萬名重度使用者支撐, 相對於全球約15億名知識工作者, AI的普及程度仍處於非常早期的階段。他表示, 在AI原生企業中, 部分高頻使用AI的工程師Token消耗量可能達到一般工程師的10至100倍, 顯示企業內部的AI使用也呈現高度集中。
這種需求結構也讓Baker認為, AI基礎設施可能不是「蓋太多」, 而是「蓋得不夠快」。他指出, AI資料中心的建設規模已經大到足以影響電力、半導體、銅材及其他相關產業的原始供給能力。隨著AI伺服器持續增加, 從晶片到電力設備、變壓器、冷卻系統及資料中心土地, 都可能成為限制算力擴張的瓶頸。
Baker尤其看好AI資料中心的資本回報速度。他引用Nebius及CoreWeave等新型雲端業者的經驗指出, 以輝達(NVDA-US) GPU為核心的1GW資料中心, 完整建置成本約400億至500億美元, 而部分客戶會預付約50%至60%的費用, 因此營運商實際需要先行投入的資金可大幅低於總建置成本。若資料中心上線後能以現貨市場價格出租算力, 投資回收期可能縮短至約9至10個月。
換言之, 一座成本約500億美元的1GW級AI資料中心, 在特定融資及出租條件下, 有機會在不到一年內收回前期投入資金。Baker認為, 對他的職業生涯而言, 如此龐大規模的資本投入能夠搭配如此短的回收週期, 是極為罕見的投資機會。

目前AI資料中心的融資條件也正在降低大型建設項目的資本門檻。Baker指出, 輝達GPU本身已具備相對成熟的融資市場, 黑石集團(Blackstone, BX-US)、KKR(KKR-US)及阿波羅全球管理(Apollo Global Management, APO-US)等大型資產管理機構均參與相關融資。a16z對Baker訪談內容的整理顯示, 在一個約500億美元的輝達GPU資料中心部署案例中, 約350億美元可以透過低成本債務融資, 使股東實際需要承擔的股本投入降至約150億美元, 並搭配剩餘價值保障機制。
Baker認為, 隨著AI模型能力提升及GPU使用週期延長, 單位算力的變現效率仍有提高空間。因此, 如果AI服務需求持續快速成長, 實際股權資金回收期甚至可能短於目前估計的9至10個月。
AI模型供應商的資源配置策略也正在出現分化。Baker認為, 前沿模型、開放權重模型及應用程式公司並非必然形成零和競爭, 不同類型的AI企業可以同時受益於整體Token需求增加。
在前沿模型領域, OpenAI與Anthropic仍處於高度競爭狀態。兩家公司都掌握尚未發布的新模型, 因而可以根據競爭對手的產品節奏及市場需求調整模型發布時間, 同時在訓練與推理之間重新配置有限的算力資源。這種資源配置甚至可能直接影響短期營收表現, 因為同一批GPU可以選擇投入模型訓練, 也可以轉向具有直接收入的推理服務。
大型科技企業的策略同樣開始分化。Meta Platforms(META-US)重新加速前沿模型競爭, Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則在部分前沿模型競賽上更加謹慎, 並透過對外提供TPU算力增加現金流來源。
Baker也提醒, 市場容易把「開放權重」與真正的「開源」混為一談。即使模型權重開放, 產生Token仍然需要大量算力。在相同使用條件下, 開放模型並不代表Token的運算成本可以消失, 主要差異在於模型服務商的毛利率及商業模式。
他認為, 開放模型價格下降反而可能刺激整體AI使用量增加。企業可以把成本較低的開放模型部署在內部, 處理大量重複性或標準化任務, 再把需要複雜推理及規劃能力的工作交給前沿模型。
因此, 企業可能逐漸採用「前沿模型+私有化微調開放模型」的混合架構。企業可以使用自身資料訓練專屬模型, 並透過路由系統決定不同任務應該交給哪一種模型。需要複雜推理的任務交給前沿模型, 一般工作則由成本較低的自有模型完成, 同時降低資料外流及隱私風險。
Baker認為, 下一場競爭可能集中在所謂「智慧抽象層」, 也就是企業及一般使用者取得AI能力的統一入口。使用者只需要提出需求, 後端系統便自行決定應該呼叫哪一個模型、如何分配算力以及如何保護資料。
微軟(MSFT-US)、Fireworks、Databricks以及各類垂直型Agent企業都在爭奪這一入口。Baker認為, 真正的競爭不只是模型能力, 還包括不同模型之間的無縫調度、資料安全、成本控制及執行可靠性。
在市場對AI泡沫的討論中, Baker也承認歷史經驗仍值得參考。每當一項顛覆性技術出現, 資產價格通常會先上升, 隨後吸引大量資本進入並造成過度建設。但他認為, 此輪AI基礎設施投資與過去部分科技泡沫存在重要差異, 因為目前相當一部分支出由大型科技企業強勁的營業現金流支撐, 而不是完全依賴高槓桿債務融資。
不過, 這並不代表市場完全沒有風險。Baker警告, 即使到2028年, 如果目前已公布的AI資料中心建設計畫全部完成, 市場也可能仍然缺乏大量閒置產能。電力供應、土地、許可及政治因素都可能使實際建設速度低於紙面上的規劃速度。
如果供給始終處於緊張狀態, Token價格下降的速度可能低於市場預期, 極端情況下甚至可能在需求暴增時上升。這將產生明顯的「算力不平等」問題, 因為大型企業及資金雄厚的使用者可以承受高昂的前沿模型成本, 中小企業及一般使用者則可能被迫使用功能較弱的模型。
Baker近期也曾在社群平台指出, AI使用規模快速擴大將使算力支出成為企業競爭力的重要因素。他預期, 未來許多知識型產業可能形成一個最低AI Token支出門檻, 企業若無法負擔足夠的算力, 可能逐漸失去競爭力。這也是他所警告的「算力不平等」。
他的觀點也得到部分市場人士呼應。黑石集團執行長Larry Fink此前警告, AI龐大的採用成本可能造成「K型經濟」, 電力、半導體及資料處理能力的短缺, 將讓資本實力較強的企業取得更大優勢。Fink甚至預測, 算力本身未來可能形成新的資產類別。
Baker同時認為, 微軟此前相對謹慎的資本支出策略可能成為反面教材。他提到, 微軟去年曾宣布規模約800億美元的AI資料中心資本支出計畫, 隨後一度放慢部分建設速度, 而他認為公司如今可能對此感到後悔。相較之下, OpenAI持續大規模投入算力, 在Baker看來已經證明激進建設策略具有回報。
整體而言, Baker的核心論點並不是AI基礎設施完全不存在泡沫, 而是市場可能高估了「過度建設」的風險, 卻低估AI使用普及後所帶來的新增需求。當前AI產業的收入主要仍由不到1,000萬名重度使用者貢獻, 但潛在市場卻涵蓋約15億名知識工作者。只要AI從少數高頻使用者進一步擴散至更廣泛的企業及個人, 算力需求便可能出現遠高於目前市場預期的增長。
Baker因此認為, AI真正的瓶頸可能不是模型缺乏需求, 而是電力、GPU、資料中心及相關基礎設施無法以足夠快的速度增加。對投資人而言, 未來AI產業的關鍵問題可能也將從「會不會過度建設」轉向「供給能否趕上需求」。
如果AI應用持續滲透企業日常工作, 資料中心、GPU、電力及高速網路的需求仍可能維持強勁。反之, 若AI普及速度不如預期, 巨額資料中心投資則可能面臨利用率不足及資本回收期延長的風險。這場供需賽跑, 將成為決定下一階段AI投資熱潮能否延續的關鍵。
paras_en: Renowned investor and Atreides Management founder and CIO Gavin Baker recently offered a starkly different view on the outlook for AI infrastructure. He believes that the market’s current biggest worry—AI data centers being “overbuilt”—may not be the real risk; the greater danger is insufficient compute supply. Baker notes that there are roughly 1.5 billion knowledge workers worldwide, yet only a tiny fraction are heavy AI users today, and as AI spreads further, compute demand could far outstrip existing supply.

In an a16z podcast aired on August 31, Baker said AI demand is just beginning to diffuse, while constraints in power, chips, copper, data‑center construction and government approvals are collectively throttling the pace of new compute capacity. He even warned that if supply can’t keep up long‑term, AI service prices may not fall as broadly expected, and could instead lead to “compute inequality,” where large firms and well‑funded users grab the most advanced AI capabilities first.

Baker cited Atreides’ own usage as an example of rapidly heating demand. He revealed that internal token consumption rose 100‑fold from March to August, and after recently acquiring a Grok Enterprise license, just two employees could boost a month’s token spend another 10‑to‑20 times. Baker stressed this isn’t wasteful spending; it reflects AI becoming embedded in investment research and other knowledge‑intensive work, driving genuinely higher usage.

a16z partner David George pointed out that today AI industry revenue is still supported by fewer than 10 million heavy users, which is a tiny slice of the roughly 1.5 billion knowledge workers globally, indicating AI adoption is still in a very early stage. He added that within AI‑native firms, some engineers who use AI heavily may consume tokens at 10‑to‑100 times the rate of an average engineer, showing a highly concentrated internal usage pattern.

This demand structure leads Baker to argue that AI infrastructure isn’t being “overbuilt” but rather “under‑built fast enough.” He noted that the scale of AI data‑center construction is already large enough to affect the primary supply capacity of power, semiconductors, copper and related industries. As AI servers proliferate, everything from chips to power equipment, transformers, cooling systems and data‑center land could become bottlenecks to compute expansion.

Baker is especially bullish on the capital return speed of AI data centers. Citing newer cloud players such as Nebius and CoreWeave, he said a 1 GW data center built around NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GPUs costs roughly $40‑$50 billion to fully construct, but many customers pre‑pay 50‑60 % of fees, meaning operators need to front far less capital than the total build cost. If the center rents compute at spot‑market rates, the payback period could shrink to about nine to ten months.

In other words, a $50 billion, 1 GW‑class AI data center could recoup its upfront investment in under a year under certain financing and leasing conditions. Baker believes that, for his career, such massive capital deployment paired with such a short recovery window is an exceptionally rare investment opportunity.

Financing terms for AI data centers are also lowering the capital barrier for large projects. Baker noted that NVIDIA GPUs already have a relatively mature financing market, with major asset managers like Blackstone (BX‑US), KKR (KKR‑US) and Apollo Global Management (APO‑US) participating in related deals. a16z’s summary of Baker’s interview shows that in a roughly $50 billion NVIDIA‑GPU deployment case, about $35 billion could be financed with low‑cost debt, reducing shareholders’ equity outlay to roughly $15 billion, supplemented by residual value protection mechanisms.

Baker believes that as AI model capabilities improve and GPU usage cycles lengthen, the monetisation efficiency per unit of compute still has room to improve. Thus, if AI service demand continues to grow rapidly, the actual equity cash‑recovery period could be even shorter than the currently estimated nine‑to‑ten months.

AI model providers’ resource‑allocation strategies are also diverging. Baker says frontier models, open‑weight models and application‑focused companies need not be in a zero‑sum battle; different types of AI firms can all benefit from the overall rise in token demand.

In the frontier‑model arena, OpenAI and Anthropic remain in fierce competition. Both hold unreleased next‑generation models, allowing them to time releases based on rivals’ product cycles and market demand, while reallocating limited compute between training and inference. This allocation can directly affect short‑term revenue, as the same GPUs can be shifted from model training to revenue‑generating inference services.

Large‑tech strategies are also fragmenting. Meta Platforms (META‑US) has re‑accelerated its push in frontier models, while Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Google’s parent, is taking a more cautious stance in some frontier‑model contests and is generating cash flow by offering external TPU compute.

Baker cautions that markets often conflate “open‑weight” with true “open‑source.” Even when model weights are open, generating tokens still requires massive compute. Under identical usage conditions, open models do not eliminate token compute costs; the main differences lie in the provider’s margin and business model.

He argues that lower prices for open models could actually spur overall AI usage. Companies can deploy cheaper open models internally for high‑volume, repetitive or standardized tasks, reserving frontier models for work that needs complex reasoning and planning capabilities.

Consequently, firms may increasingly adopt a hybrid architecture of “frontier model + privately‑fine‑tuned open model.” They can train proprietary models on their own data and use routing systems to decide which model handles each task—complex reasoning goes to frontier models, routine work to lower‑cost in‑house models—while also reducing data leakage and privacy risks.

Baker sees the next competitive front focusing on the so‑called “intelligent abstraction layer,” the unified entry point through which enterprises and general users access AI capabilities. Users simply state their need, and the backend automatically selects the appropriate model, allocates compute and safeguards data.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Fireworks, Databricks and a host of vertical‑focused agent companies are all vying for this entry point. Baker believes the real competition isn’t just model performance but also seamless orchestration among models, data security, cost control and execution reliability.

Discussing AI‑bubble narratives, Baker acknowledges that history still offers lessons. Whenever a disruptive technology emerges, asset prices typically rise first, then attract massive capital inflows that can lead to over‑construction. However, he argues this wave of AI‑infrastructure investment differs from past tech bubbles because a sizable share of spending is backed by strong operating cash flows from large tech firms, not solely by highly leveraged debt.

That said, risk remains. Baker warns that even by 2028, if all announced AI data‑center projects are completed, the market may still lack abundant idle capacity. Power supply, land, permits and political factors could cause actual construction speed to lag behind paper‑based plans.

If supply stays tight, token price declines may be slower than market expectations, and in extreme cases token prices could even rise amid a demand surge. This would create a clear “compute inequality” problem, where large, well‑funded enterprises can afford pricey frontier models while SMEs and average users are forced onto weaker‑performing models.

Baker recently noted on social platforms that the rapid expansion of AI usage will make compute spend a key competitive factor for firms. He predicts many knowledge‑intensive industries will develop a minimum AI‑token‑spend threshold, and companies that cannot afford sufficient compute may gradually lose competitiveness—another facet of the “compute inequality” he warns about.

His view is echoed by some market participants. Blackstone CEO Larry Fink previously warned that the massive adoption cost of AI could create a “K‑shaped economy,” with shortages in power, semiconductors and data‑processing capacity giving capital‑rich firms a distinct advantage. Fink even forecasts that compute itself could become a new asset class in the future.

Baker also points out that Microsoft’s previously cautious cap‑ex strategy may serve as a cautionary tale. He notes Microsoft announced an roughly $80 billion AI data‑center cap‑ex plan last year, then slowed parts of the build, and he believes the company may now regret that slowdown. By contrast, OpenAI’s continued massive compute investment, in Baker’s view, demonstrates that an aggressive build‑out can pay off.

Overall, Baker’s core argument isn’t that AI infrastructure lacks any bubble, but that the market may overestimate the risk of “over‑building” while underestimating the surge in demand that broader AI adoption will generate. Today, AI industry revenue still comes from fewer than 10 million heavy users, yet the potential market spans roughly 1.5 billion knowledge workers. As AI spreads from a small group of high‑frequency users to a wider base of enterprises and individuals, compute demand could grow far beyond current market forecasts.

Thus, Baker concludes that the real bottleneck isn’t a lack of model demand, but the inability of power, GPUs, data‑centers and related infrastructure to scale quickly enough. For investors, the key question may shift from “Will we over‑build?” to “Can supply keep up with demand?”

If AI applications continue to permeate everyday enterprise work, demand for data‑centers, GPUs, power and high‑speed networking is likely to stay strong. Conversely, if AI adoption lags expectations, massive data‑center investments could face under‑utilisation and longer capital‑recovery periods. This supply‑demand race will be decisive in whether the next wave of AI investment momentum can be sustained.

items.title: 美軍擴大空襲伊朗 穆吉塔巴揚言給美國「難忘教訓」 川普警告勿報復
items.title_en: U.S. Expands Air Strikes on Iran; Mujahedin Warns of 'Unforgettable Lesson' for America, Trump Warns Against Retaliation
paras: 美軍以伊朗企圖攻擊荷姆茲海峽航運及襲擊美軍基地為由，週二 (1日) 對伊朗發動新一輪空襲。伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴隨即揚言，伊朗及「抵抗陣線」將給美國這個敵人「難忘的教訓」；伊朗軍方與伊斯蘭革命衛隊 (IRGC) 也誓言嚴厲反擊。
美國總統川普則稱這次軍事行動「正當合理」，並警告德黑蘭不要報復，否則美方將發動「更強硬、更高等級」的打擊，美伊衝突進一步升級。
美國中央司令部表示，美軍於美東時間週二中午 12 時、格林威治時間下午 4 時開始攻擊伊朗境內目標。
伊朗媒體陸續通報，阿薩盧耶、吉羅夫特、阿巴斯港、格什姆島、科納拉克、查巴哈、賈斯克、錫里克及拉萬等地傳出爆炸。
川普在 Truth Social 發文表示，這次空襲是為了報復伊朗企圖在荷姆茲海峽增設水雷，以及向美軍位於約旦的基地發射 8 枚飛彈。
川普接受福斯新聞訪問時表示，美方在發動空襲前已通知波斯灣盟友。他也再次警告伊朗不要反擊，並稱喬治華盛頓號航空母艦已做好充分準備。
市場擔憂衝突持續擴大，可能進一步干擾荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸。國際油價週二大幅走高。
西德州中級原油 (WTI) 期貨上漲 5.9%，收在每桶 90.82 美元，重新站上 90 美元關卡。油價急升也加劇通膨疑慮，帶動全球公債殖利率攀升，並提高市場對來準會 (Fed) 9月升息的押注。
伊朗誓言反擊 革命衛隊宣稱襲擊約旦美軍營區
穆吉塔巴在美軍開始空襲後透過社群平台 X 表示：「親愛的伊朗及抵抗陣線，將給美國這個敵人『難忘的教訓』。」
伊朗軍方與革命衛隊也發表聲明，指控美國發動侵略，並揚言美方將為此感到後悔、面臨「嚴厲懲罰」。
革命衛隊隨後宣稱，已向約旦亞喀巴灣附近的 Titin 營區發射彈道飛彈，鎖定當地一處美國海軍陸戰隊營區。革命衛隊聲稱，攻擊造成多名美軍死亡，並摧毀數處設施及攻擊直升機，但相關說法尚未獲得美方證實。
革命衛隊並表示，只要美軍繼續攻擊伊朗南部，伊方就會持續採取報復行動。
敘利亞南部德拉省東部上空另有 3 枚飛彈遭到攔截，據報這批飛彈原本飛往約旦。約旦馬弗拉克也傳出攔截火箭的消息。
伊朗稱美軍空襲釀 4 死逾 50 傷
伊朗法斯通訊社援引當地紅新月會說法報導，美軍空襲錫里克附近一處住宅，造成 4 人死亡，其中包括 1 名兒童，另有超過 50 人受傷。
伊朗媒體稱，遇襲地點當時正在舉行婚禮，搜救工作仍在進行。伊朗西部胡齊斯坦省首府阿瓦士郊區也遭到美軍飛彈攻擊，相關消息由法斯通訊社援引當地安全官員說法報導。
白宮拒信伊朗談判訊號 制裁將持續
白宮消息人士表示，川普政府認為，伊朗總統近期釋出的訊息不足以構成重啟談判的基礎。川普已表明不相信伊朗會以善意參與談判。
美國眾議院共和黨籍議長強生也重申，伊朗不值得信任。相關表態顯示，美國目前無意改變對伊朗的施壓路線，既有制裁措施也將繼續實施。
隨著美軍擴大空襲、伊朗革命衛隊宣稱發動反擊，加上雙方領導人相互發出強硬警告，美伊短期內重返談判桌的可能性進一步降低。
paras_en: The U.S. launched a new round of air strikes on Iran on Tuesday (1st) citing Iran’s attempt to attack shipping in the Hormuz Strait and to strike U.S. bases as justification. Iranian Supreme Leader Mujahedin immediately threatened that Iran and the “Resistance Front” would give the enemy America an unforgettable lesson; the Iranian military and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) also vowed a severe counter‑attack.

President Trump called the military action “justified and reasonable” and warned Tehran not to retaliate, or the U.S. would launch “harder, higher‑level” strikes, further escalating the U.S.–Iran conflict.
The U.S. Central Command said the U.S. forces began attacking Iranian targets at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, which is 4:00 p.m. Greenwich Mean Time.
Iranian media reported explosions in Asaluyeh, Jiroft, Abadan Port, Kish Island, Konarak, Chabahar, Jask, Sirik, and Lavan.
Trump posted on Truth Social that the air strikes were in retaliation for Iran’s attempt to lay mines in the Hormuz Strait and for launching eight missiles at U.S. bases in Jordan.

During an interview with Fox News, Trump said the U.S. had notified its Gulf allies before launching the air strikes. He again warned Iran against retaliation and said the USS George Washington aircraft carrier was fully prepared.
Markets worried that the conflict could expand further and disrupt oil transport through the Hormuz Strait. International oil prices spiked sharply on Tuesday.

West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures rose 5.9%, closing at $90.82 a barrel, re‑crossing the $90 level. The price surge also heightened inflation concerns, pushed global government bond yields higher, and increased bets on a Fed rate hike in September.
Iran vows retaliation; the Revolutionary Guard claims to have attacked a U.S. base in Jordan.
Mujahedin posted on X after the U.S. began the air strikes, saying: “Dear Iranians and the Resistance Front, we will give this enemy America an unforgettable lesson.”
The Iranian military and the Revolutionary Guard issued a statement accusing the U.S. of aggression and warned that the U.S. would regret the action and face “severe punishment.”

The Revolutionary Guard later claimed it had launched ballistic missiles at the Titin camp near Aqaba Bay in Jordan, targeting a U.S. Marine Corps camp. The Guard said the attack killed several U.S. soldiers, destroyed multiple facilities, and attacked helicopters, but the U.S. has not confirmed these claims.
The Revolutionary Guard stated that as long as the U.S. continues to attack southern Iran, Iran will keep retaliating.
In eastern Daraa province in southern Syria, three missiles were intercepted; reports say they were originally headed for Jordan. Jordan’s Mafraq also reported intercepting rockets.
Iran says U.S. air strikes caused 4 deaths and over 50 injuries.
According to the Iranian Fars news agency citing the local Red Crescent, U.S. air strikes on a residential area near Sirik killed four people, including a child, and injured more than 50.

Iranian media reported that the attack site was holding a wedding at the time, and rescue work was still underway. The outskirts of Ahvaz in western Khuzestan province also suffered U.S. missile attacks, according to Fars citing local security officials.
The White House rejected Iran’s signal for negotiations; sanctions will continue.

White House officials said the Trump administration believes the recent messages from the Iranian president are insufficient to restart negotiations. Trump has stated he does not believe Iran will engage in good‑faith talks.

U.S. House Republican Speaker Kevin Johnson reiterated that Iran is untrustworthy. The stance indicates the U.S. has no intention of changing its pressure line on Iran, and existing sanctions will remain in effect.

With the U.S. expanding air strikes, the IRGC claiming retaliation, and both leaders issuing hard warnings, the likelihood of a short‑term return to the negotiation table between the U.S. and Iran has further diminished.

items.title: 全球債市到底怎麼了？油價、AI與美國40兆美元債務同時引爆
items.title_en: What’s Happening in the Global Bond Market? Oil, AI and the U.S. $40 Trillion Debt Spark a Sell‑off
paras: 從美國、德國到日本，全球主要公債殖利率正攀向數十年高點。油價上漲加劇通膨疑慮、主要央行升息預期升溫，加上政府債務與人工智慧(AI)相關企業發債暴增，共同引爆這波全球債市拋售。
日本10年期公債殖利率周二(9/1)升至3%，為1996年以來首見，象徵日本正加速告別超低利率時代。英國30年期借貸成本升至30年高點，德國及法國10年期公債殖利率也分別來到2011年及2008年以來最高；美國30年期公債殖利率則曾在8月升至2007年來最高。

油價、升息與政府債務引爆公債賣壓

美伊緊張局勢推升國際油價，使原本居高不下的通膨壓力進一步升高，交易員也加大押注主要央行將繼續升息。聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)日前在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表鷹派演說，也進一步強化市場對Fed升息的預期。
政府大量舉債同樣令投資人不安。美國政府債務剛突破40兆美元，除德國外，七大工業國集團(G7)其餘成員的政府債務占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重，均已達到或超過100%。
殖利率是整體經濟借貸成本的重要基準，從政府債務、企業融資，到房貸、學貸及車貸都會受到影響。利率上升將壓抑借貸與消費，進而拖慢經濟成長。隨著美國10年期公債殖利率走高，30年期房貸利率已升至接近6.7%，創一年新高。
政府也必須以更高利率為到期債務再融資。英國預算責任辦公室指出，英國利息支出已接近GDP的4%，約為疫情前10年平均水準的兩倍，甚至超過國防預算。
公債殖利率上升也可能削弱股票吸引力。企業獲利強勁目前仍支撐股市，但高槓桿、跨市場交易的避險基金，可能因融資成本上升及債券價格下跌承受壓力。

AI巨頭發債暴增「債券義勇軍」伺機而動

科技巨頭為投入AI資料中心及模型開發而大舉發債，也增加全球債券供給。按照供需原則，借款需求暴增後，投資人可要求更高利率，進一步推升殖利率。
倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)數據顯示，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)等五大AI超大規模雲端服務業者，今年已發行2,200億美元債券，超過去年全年的兩倍。
AI投資融資熱潮也推升全球企業債發行量，今年迄今已達創紀錄的4.9兆美元，較去年同期增加14%，加重政府與企業爭奪資金的壓力。
美國財政部近期宣布擴大債券回購，一度穩定市場，但長期公債殖利率隨後再度攀升。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)則淡化債務及殖利率疑慮，強調相關看法忽略美國經濟的強勁程度。
若市場陷入失序，央行也可透過購債干預，如英國央行2022年迷你預算危機期間的做法。歐洲央行(ECB)也能透過傳導保護工具，在成員國遵守歐盟財政規範的前提下，阻止借貸成本出現不合理且失序的上升。
目前多數投資人認為，殖利率上升仍屬有序，主要反映通膨及借款需求增加。油價下跌或許能暫時減輕壓力，但若各國政府未能降低債務或提高經濟成長，俗稱「債券義勇軍」的投資人仍可能要求更高報酬，以迫使財政揮霍或抗通膨不力的政府付出代價。
paras_en: From the United States and Germany to Japan, yields on major sovereign bonds are climbing toward multi‑decade highs. Higher oil prices are stoking inflation worries, expectations of rate hikes by major central banks are heating up, and a surge in government borrowing and AI‑related corporate debt are jointly igniting a wave of global bond selling.

Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield rose to 3% on Tuesday (Sept. 1), the first time it has hit that level since 1996, signalling Japan is accelerating its exit from the ultra‑low‑rate era. In the United Kingdom, 30‑year borrowing costs rose to a 30‑year peak, while Germany’s and France’s 10‑year yields reached their highest levels since 2011 and 2008 respectively; the U.S. 30‑year yield had peaked in August at its highest since 2007.

Higher oil prices, rate hikes and government debt are fueling bond‑sell pressure. Tensions between the U.S. and Iran have pushed up international oil prices, further elevating already‑high inflation pressures, and traders are increasing bets that major central banks will keep tightening. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank meeting, reinforcing market expectations of further Fed rate hikes.

Massive government borrowing is also unsettling investors. U.S. sovereign debt has just breached $40 trillion, and aside from Germany, the debt‑to‑GDP ratios of all other G7 members have reached or exceeded 100%.

Yields are a key benchmark for overall borrowing costs in the economy, affecting government debt, corporate financing, mortgages, student loans and auto loans. Higher rates suppress borrowing and consumption, slowing growth. As the U.S. 10‑year yield climbs, 30‑year mortgage rates have risen to near 6.7%, a one‑year high.

Governments must also refinance maturing debt at higher rates. The UK Office for Budget Responsibility notes that interest outlays now approach 4% of GDP, roughly twice the pre‑pandemic ten‑year average and even exceeding the defence budget.

Rising sovereign yields could also dampen the appeal of equities. Strong corporate earnings are still supporting stocks, but highly leveraged, cross‑market hedge funds may feel pressure from higher financing costs and falling bond prices.

AI giants are flooding the market with new debt, creating a “bond volunteer army” ready to step in. Tech giants are issuing large amounts of bonds to fund AI data centres and model development, adding to global bond supply. Under supply‑demand dynamics, a surge in borrowing demand lets investors demand higher yields, pushing rates up further.

LSEG data show that the five biggest AI‑focused cloud providers – Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – have issued $220 billion of bonds this year, more than double the total issued last year.

The AI‑driven financing boom is also lifting global corporate bond issuance, which has hit a record $4.9 trillion so far this year, up 14% year‑on‑year, intensifying competition with governments for capital.

The U.S. Treasury recently announced an expanded bond buyback program, which briefly steadied markets, but long‑term yields rose again thereafter. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent downplayed debt and yield concerns, arguing that such views overlook the strength of the U.S. economy.

If markets become disordered, central banks can intervene by buying bonds, as the Bank of England did during the 2022 mini‑budget crisis. The European Central Bank can also use transmission protection tools, provided member states comply with EU fiscal rules, to prevent borrowing costs from rising irrationally and disorderly.

Most investors currently see the yield rise as orderly, reflecting higher inflation and borrowing demand. Falling oil prices may provide temporary relief, but if governments fail to reduce debt or boost growth, the so‑called “bond volunteer army” could continue demanding higher returns to punish fiscally lax or inflation‑ineffective governments.

items.title: 川普再出招限制出生公民權 美國擬要求父母申請子女護照附身分證明
items.title_en: Trump Proposes New Restrictions on Birthright Citizenship, U.S. to Require Parents to Provide Citizenship or Immigration Proof When Applying for Child's Passport
paras: 美國國務院擬要求父母申請兒童護照時，提供自身公民身分或移民身分證明，這項新措施被視為川普政府限制出生公民權政策的一環，也可能成為落實川普最新行政命令、打擊所謂「生育旅遊」的重要行政手段。
路透社取得的國務院草案指引顯示，父母在替子女申請美國護照時，可能必須提交自身公民身分或移民身分的證明文件。這是外界首次較詳細了解國務院可能如何執行川普8月6日簽署、針對「生育旅遊」並擴大出生公民權歷史例外情況的行政命令。
白宮將路透社相關問題轉交國務院。國務院發言人皮戈特(Tommy Pigott)在聲明中表示：「川普總統一直明確表示，本屆政府將保護美國公民身分的意義與價值，僅此而已，這也包括確保我們的護照審查程序充分反映這項標準。」
限制出生公民權一直是川普大幅收緊移民政策的重要目標之一。川普最初發布的行政命令規定，只有至少有一名父母為美國公民或合法永久居民(即持有綠卡者)的兒童，才能在出生時自動取得美國公民身分。
然而，美國最高法院此前以6比3裁決，認定川普最初的行政命令違法。多數大法官認為，該命令違反美國憲法第14修正案中的公民身分條款(Citizenship Clause)。
川普8月6日發布的新行政命令範圍較為狹窄，主要針對「生育旅遊」，也就是女性前往美國生產，使子女能夠依現行規定自動取得美國公民身分。不過，這項新行政命令同樣可能面臨法院阻撓。
根據國務院草案指引，新命令將限制部分兒童取得公民身分，包括父母其中一人為在美國工作的外國政府人員、涉及以欺詐或商業交易方式取得公民身分，或被列為「敵國外國人」的情況。
國務院草案明確寫道：「國務院將要求提供父母資訊，以及父母公民身分或移民身分的證據，以判定申請人是否受到行政命令第14418號(EO 14418)規範。」
如果這項提案正式實施，所有父母或法定監護人在替子女提交護照申請時，都必須提供自身身分證明。美國公民可以提交有效美國護照或出生證明等文件；非美國公民則可能需要提供I-94入境紀錄等移民文件，或合法永久居民身分證明，也就是俗稱的綠卡。
國務院將利用這些資料判斷兒童是否符合川普新行政命令下的公民身分資格。
這將大幅改變目前替美國出生子女申請護照的程序。現行制度下，父母主要需要證明自己與子女的親子關係，並提供附照片的身分證件。申請人也必須在護照申請表上勾選是否為美國公民，但目前並不要求父母另外提交證明自身公民身分的文件。
新規若落地，意味著父母自身的公民或移民身分將成為政府審查兒童護照申請的重要資料，政府可藉此判斷兒童是否受到行政命令限制。
川普政府推動這項政策之際，相關出生公民權爭議已經進入多起訴訟程序。代表可能因川普最初行政命令而失去公民身分的嬰兒提起集體訴訟的律師，已向兩名不同的聯邦法官要求阻止川普最新行政命令生效。
其中一宗案件由美國聯邦地區法官博德曼(Deborah Boardman)審理。博德曼由民主黨籍前總統拜登任命。
在上週五於馬里蘭州格林貝爾特(Greenbelt)舉行的聽證會上，博德曼對這項被她形容為川普「前所未有」的行政命令表達懷疑，並允許原告修改訴狀，使法院可以進一步考慮是否阻止該命令實施。
美國司法部律師則主張，目前不適合發布限制令，理由是聯邦政府相關機構尚未公開發布具體執行指引，因此目前對行政命令提出法律挑戰仍屬過早。
不過，國務院此次草案曝光，顯示川普政府正在逐步建立落實最新出生公民權政策的行政程序。若相關要求正式實施，父母在替美國出生子女申請護照時，除須證明親子關係外，也可能首次被要求證明自身的公民或移民身分。
這項政策的最終內容及能否實際執行，仍取決於國務院後續發布的正式規定以及聯邦法院對相關訴訟的裁決。由於川普政府限制出生公民權的政策已遭遇憲法爭議，新護照審查制度也可能成為下一波法律攻防的焦點。
paras_en: The U.S. State Department is set to require parents to provide proof of their own citizenship or immigration status when applying for a child’s passport, a move seen as part of the Trump administration’s effort to limit birthright citizenship and potentially a key tool for enforcing Trump’s latest executive order aimed at curbing so‑called “birth tourism.”

A draft guidance obtained by Reuters shows that parents may have to submit documentation of their citizenship or immigration status when applying for a U.S. passport for their children. This is the first detailed look at how the State Department might implement the executive order signed by Trump on August 6, which expands historical exceptions to birthright citizenship for “birth tourism.”

The White House referred Reuters’ questions to the State Department. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a statement, “President Trump has repeatedly made clear that this administration will protect the meaning and value of U.S. citizenship, and that includes ensuring our passport review process fully reflects that standard.”

Limiting birthright citizenship has been a major pillar of Trump’s broader immigration crackdown. The original executive order stipulated that a child could automatically acquire U.S. citizenship at birth only if at least one parent was a U.S. citizen or a lawful permanent resident (green‑card holder).

However, the Supreme Court previously struck down Trump’s original order by a 6‑3 vote, finding it unconstitutional. A majority of justices held that the order violated the Citizenship Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

Trump’s August 6 order is narrower, targeting “birth tourism”—women traveling to the United States to give birth so their children automatically receive citizenship under current law. Yet the new order could also face judicial obstacles.

According to the State Department draft, the new rule would restrict citizenship for certain children, including those whose parent is a foreign government employee working in the United States, those involved in fraud or commercial transactions to obtain citizenship, or those classified as “foreign nationals of hostile nations.”

The draft explicitly states, “The State Department will require parental information and evidence of the parent’s citizenship or immigration status to determine whether the applicant is subject to Executive Order 14418.”

If the proposal is finalized, every parent or legal guardian submitting a passport application for a child would have to provide proof of their own status. U.S. citizens could submit a valid U.S. passport or birth certificate; non‑citizens might need to provide an I‑94 arrival record, other immigration documents, or proof of lawful permanent residency (a green card).
The State Department will use this information to decide whether the child meets the citizenship eligibility criteria under Trump’s new executive order.

This would dramatically change the current process for obtaining passports for children born in the United States. Under the existing system, parents mainly need to prove the parent‑child relationship and provide a photo ID. Applicants also check a box on the passport form indicating citizenship, but they are not required to submit separate proof of the parents’ citizenship.

If enacted, the new rule would make a parent’s own citizenship or immigration status a key factor in the government’s review of a child’s passport application, allowing officials to determine whether the child falls under the executive‑order restrictions.

The policy push comes as multiple lawsuits challenging birthright‑citizenship restrictions are already underway. Lawyers representing infants who could lose citizenship under Trump’s original order have asked two different federal judges to block the new order from taking effect.
One case is before U.S. District Judge Deborah Boardman, a Biden‑appointed Democrat.

At a hearing last Friday in Greenbelt, Maryland, Judge Boardman expressed skepticism about what she called an “unprecedented” Trump order and allowed the plaintiffs to amend their complaint so the court can further consider whether to block its implementation.

The Justice Department’s lawyers argue that it is premature to issue an injunction because the relevant federal agencies have not yet released concrete implementation guidance, making a legal challenge to the order too early.

Nevertheless, the State Department’s draft leak shows the Trump administration is gradually building the administrative machinery to enforce its latest birthright‑citizenship policy. If the requirements become official, parents applying for passports for U.S.-born children may for the first time have to prove their own citizenship or immigration status in addition to the parent‑child relationship.

The final content of the policy and its enforceability will depend on the State Department’s forthcoming regulations and on how federal courts rule on the pending lawsuits. Because Trump’s birthright‑citizenship restrictions have already sparked constitutional disputes, the new passport‑review system could become the next front line in legal battles.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 美伊衝突升溫、債市遭拋售
paras: 美元周二(1日)走強，在油價飆升及債券市場遭拋售背景下，受到避險需求支撐。另一方面，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)敦促東京升息後，日元走弱，歐元則在通膨數據公布後下滑。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.69。
美國中央司令部(CENTCOM)周二表示，美軍已對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)目標發動攻擊，伊朗官媒則表示，攻擊擊中葛希姆島(Qeshm)一座工廠，以及霍爾木茲甘省(Hormozgan)的非軍事目標，美元因此受到避險買盤支撐。
在上周末之前，美國與伊朗一直因霍爾木茲海峽的控制權問題陷入僵局，而美國總統川普似乎已將策略從軍事打擊轉向經濟戰。
然而，周日軍事行動重新恢復。這是自7月以來首次恢復直接軍事行動。美國中央司令部表示，美軍對在霍爾木茲海峽布設水雷的伊朗革命衛隊部隊採取了「有限且精準的行動」。
伊朗隨後展開報復，對位於約旦的美軍基地發動攻擊。約旦官媒則另行報導，約旦成功攔截並摧毀8枚飛彈。
川普周二表示，最新一輪攻擊是為了回應伊朗布雷行動，以及對約旦軍事基地發動的攻擊。
油價周一已經上漲，周二在美軍發動新一輪攻擊後漲勢進一步擴大。11月到期的布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨最新上漲5.3%，至每桶95.25美元，10月到期的美國西德州中級原油期貨(WTI)突破每桶90美元，創6月11日以來首次。
Macquarie外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「相對而言，美元仍能從較高的原油價格中受益。當原油價格偏高時，美國的貿易條件改善、實質所得增加，貿易逆差也會縮小。過去的情況也顯示，即使原油供應受到不利衝擊，美元仍具一定的承受能力。」
債券遭拋售
周二美國公債殖利率及其他主要債市的拋售進一步加劇，市場對通膨與財政債務的擔憂升溫。美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，2年期公債殖利率也升至2024年7月以來最高。
自聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度經濟政策研討會發表偏鷹的主題演講後，市場對9月升息的預期大幅升溫。
本周市場原本聚焦通膨，但現在貨幣政策觀察人士也將注意力轉向美國勞動市場，希望從最新數據中尋找聯準會未來政策方向的更多線索。
周二公布的最新職位空缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)顯示，美國7月職缺數為727.1萬個，低於市場預期的733萬，但仍高於經下修後的6月718.2萬。
雖然7月職缺數低於預期，但職缺數較6月增加，而且整體水準仍接近4月創下的兩年高點758.5萬，顯示美國就業市場仍具韌性。
這讓聯準會在是否立即收緊貨幣政策方面獲得一些喘息空間，市場利率預期也反映了這點。
根據CME FedWatch工具，JOLTS數據公布後，市場預期聯準會9月升息1碼的機率約為68%，維持利率不變的機率則接近32%，兩者與前一日相比都沒有太大變化。
現在市場焦點已轉向周五公布的美國8月非農就業報告。
歐元走弱 日元連續第三日再度觸及160
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1歐元兌1.1587美元。
歐盟統計局(Eurostat)稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區8月整體消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率加速至3.3%，明顯高於7月的2.9%。
不過，排除波動較大的能源、食品、酒類及菸草後的核心CPI，年增率意外從2.5%降至2.4%，服務通膨則放緩至3%。
日元兌美元走弱，美元兌日元上漲0.3%，至160.22。
160日元兌1美元是市場高度關注的關卡，過去曾觸發日本政府干預匯市，包括7月底日本與美國進行的一次歷史性聯合干預行動。
美國財政部長貝森特在G20財長會議期間，公開敦促日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)升息。
貝森特此舉被視為釋放「安倍經濟學」(Abenomics)時代結束的訊號。他並表示，自己掌握了一些市場目前並不知道、與日本穩定匯率措施有關的「資訊」。
換匯市場隨後提高對日本銀行9月升息的預期，目前升息機率接近88%。這項偏鷹的政策預期也推動日本10年期公債殖利率突破3%，創1996年8月以來首次。

items.title: 中國版「曼哈頓計畫」遇瓶頸 瑞銀：十年內難追上ASML頂尖EUV
items.title_en: China’s ‘Manhattan Project’ Hits Bottleneck, UBS Says EUV Will Not Catch Up in Ten Years
paras: 多家外媒報導，瑞銀最新研究指出，中國微影製程技術仍明顯落後艾司摩爾 (ASML)，未來10年內不太可能推出足以取代極紫外光 (EUV) 微影設備的產品。不過，中國在浸潤式深紫外光 (DUV) 微影設備上的進展較快，最快2至5年便可能具備大規模生產能力。
為突破西方半導體設備出口管制，中國由國家主導，在深圳秘密推動國產EUV微影設備研發，並打造出原型機。這項國家級秘密工程因動員規模龐大、戰略重要性高，被外界稱為中國版「曼哈頓計畫」。
瑞銀的評估意味，中國短期內仍難以突破最先進晶片的生產瓶頸，但在成熟及部分先進製程設備上，對進口產品的依賴可望逐步下降。
ASML ADR (ASML-US) 週二隨大盤收跌 1.82%，報每股 1,665.14 美元，盤中最低下探 1,651.21 美元，最高觸及 1,683.74 美元，成交量約 90.57 萬股，低於平均成交量約 185.27 萬股。
中國EUV進度約相當於ASML 2004年
以Francois-Xavier Bouvignies為首的瑞銀分析師團隊，檢視中國在光源及雷射子系統等領域的專利活動後認為，中國目前的EUV技術成熟度，大致相當於ASML在2004年的發展階段。
ASML直到約15年後才開始大規模生產EUV設備。瑞銀據此推估，中國未來10年內仍難以開發出具商業可行性、足以取代ASML的EUV設備。
瑞銀也指出，即使中國成功推出自製EUV設備，其良率與產能效率仍可能落後ASML，加上監管限制，相關設備不太可能在中國以外市場廣泛部署。
浸潤式DUV最快2至5年量產
相較於EUV設備，中國在浸潤式DUV領域的追趕速度更快。瑞銀預估，中國可望在2至5年內建立大規模製造能力，但由於外界難以掌握設備實際效能，以及中國半導體供應鏈的完整程度，這項預測仍存在不確定性。
浸潤式DUV雖然不及EUV先進，仍是晶片製造的重要設備，利用光線將精細電路圖案轉印至矽晶圓。ASML每台浸潤式DUV設備售價接近9,000萬美元，EUV設備單價則超過2億美元。
荷蘭出口管制面臨時間壓力
ASML是全球唯一能夠生產先進EUV微影設備的公司。受到美國主導的出口限制影響，該公司不得向中國出售EUV系統。
荷蘭政府也自2024年9月7日起，將NXT:1970i與NXT:1980i等浸潤式DUV設備納入出口許可管理；更先進的NXT:2000i及後續機型，原本就受到荷蘭政府管制。
然而，若中國在2至5年內實現浸潤式DUV設備量產，荷蘭目前最具實際影響力的出口管制工具，可能在中國縮小EUV技術差距前便逐漸失效。
ASML執行長Christophe Fouquet曾於2024年表示，以國家安全為由限制設備出口的說法越來越難成立，相關措施背後帶有經濟考量。
中國市場仍牽動ASML營運
中國積極投入國家資金扶植本土半導體產業，希望降低對外國技術的依賴，但先進設備出口限制仍持續拖慢其發展。
另一方面，中國也是ASML的重要市場，2025年第三季占公司淨銷售額42%。ASML先前已警告，中國業務今年可能大幅下滑。
不過，ASML第一季仍繳出88億歐元淨銷售額及28億歐元淨利，全年營收財測維持在360億至400億歐元。該公司股價週二在阿姆斯特丹下跌1.6%。
瑞銀的分析顯示，中國要追上全球最尖端的EUV技術仍有一段距離，但在浸潤式DUV設備方面，進口替代的時間可能比外界預期更近。對歐洲而言，真正需要關注的不只是中國何時追上EUV技術，還包括現有出口管制的影響力能維持多久。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reports indicate that UBS’s latest research finds China’s photolithography process technology still lags significantly behind ASML, and it is unlikely that China will produce a product capable of replacing EUV lithography equipment within the next ten years. However, China’s progress in immersion deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment is faster, and it could achieve large‑scale production capability within 2 to 5 years.

To break through Western semiconductor equipment export controls, China, led by the state, has secretly promoted domestic EUV lithography equipment development in Shenzhen and built a prototype. This national‑level secret project, due to its large mobilization scale and strategic importance, has been dubbed China’s version of the Manhattan Project.

UBS’s assessment implies that China will still struggle to overcome the production bottleneck of the most advanced chips in the short term, but its dependence on imported products could gradually decline in mature and some advanced process equipment.

ASML ADR (ASML-US) fell 1.82% on Tuesday, trading at $1,665.14 per share, with a low of $1,651.21 and a high of $1,683.74, and a volume of about 905,700 shares, below the average volume of about 1,852,700 shares.
China’s EUV progress is roughly equivalent to ASML in 2004.

Led by Francois‑Xavier Bouvignies, UBS’s analyst team reviewed China’s patent activity in areas such as light sources and laser subsystems and concluded that China’s current EUV technology maturity is roughly equivalent to ASML’s 2004 development stage.

ASML did not begin large‑scale EUV production until about 15 years later. UBS therefore estimates that China will still find it difficult to develop commercially viable EUV equipment that can replace ASML within the next ten years.

UBS also noted that even if China successfully launches its own EUV equipment, its yield and production efficiency may still lag behind ASML, and regulatory restrictions mean such equipment is unlikely to be widely deployed outside China.
Immersion DUV could reach mass production in 2 to 5 years

Compared with EUV equipment, China’s pursuit of immersion DUV is faster. UBS estimates that China could establish large‑scale manufacturing capability within 2 to 5 years, but uncertainty remains due to the difficulty of assessing actual equipment performance and the completeness of China’s semiconductor supply chain.

Immersion DUV, while not as advanced as EUV, remains an important device for chip manufacturing, using light to transfer fine circuit patterns onto silicon wafers. Each immersion DUV machine from ASML sells for nearly $90 million, while EUV machines cost over $200 million.
Dutch export controls face time pressure
ASML is the only company in the world that can produce advanced EUV lithography equipment. Due to U.S.‑led export restrictions, the company cannot sell EUV systems to China.

The Dutch government has also included immersion DUV equipment such as NXT:1970i and NXT:1980i under export license management since September 7, 2024; the more advanced NXT:2000i and subsequent models were already under Dutch government control.

However, if China achieves immersion DUV mass production within 2 to 5 years, the Dutch government’s most practically effective export control tool may gradually become ineffective before China narrows the EUV technology gap.

ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said in 2024 that the justification of restricting equipment exports on national security grounds is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain, and that the measures have economic considerations behind them.
China’s market still affects ASML’s operations

China is actively investing state funds to support its domestic semiconductor industry, hoping to reduce dependence on foreign technology, but advanced equipment export restrictions continue to slow its development.
On the other hand, China is also an important market for ASML, accounting for 42% of the company’s net sales in Q3 2025. ASML has warned that its China business could see a sharp decline this year.

However, ASML posted net sales of €8.8 billion and net profit of €2.8 billion in Q1, with annual revenue forecasts of €36 billion to €40 billion. The company’s shares fell 1.6% in Amsterdam on Tuesday.

UBS’s analysis shows that China still has a distance to cover to catch up with the world’s most advanced EUV technology, but the timeline for replacing imports in immersion DUV equipment may be closer than expected. For Europe, the real concern is not just when China will catch up with EUV technology, but how long existing export controls will remain effective.

美國中央司令部(CENTCOM)周二表示，美軍已對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)目標發動攻擊，伊朗官媒則表示，攻擊擊中葛希姆島(Qeshm)一座工廠，以及霍爾木茲甘省(Hormozgan)的非軍事目標，美元因此受到避險買盤支撐。
在上周末之前，美國與伊朗一直因霍爾木茲海峽的控制權問題陷入僵局，而美國總統川普似乎已將策略從軍事打擊轉向經濟戰。
然而，周日軍事行動重新恢復。這是自7月以來首次恢復直接軍事行動。美國中央司令部表示，美軍對在霍爾木茲海峽布設水雷的伊朗革命衛隊部隊採取了「有限且精準的行動」。
伊朗隨後展開報復，對位於約旦的美軍基地發動攻擊。約旦官媒則另行報導，約旦成功攔截並摧毀8枚飛彈。
川普周二表示，最新一輪攻擊是為了回應伊朗布雷行動，以及對約旦軍事基地發動的攻擊。
油價周一已經上漲，周二在美軍發動新一輪攻擊後漲勢進一步擴大。11月到期的布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨最新上漲5.3%，至每桶95.25美元，10月到期的美國西德州中級原油期貨(WTI)突破每桶90美元，創6月11日以來首次。
Macquarie外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「相對而言，美元仍能從較高的原油價格中受益。當原油價格偏高時，美國的貿易條件改善、實質所得增加，貿易逆差也會縮小。過去的情況也顯示，即使原油供應受到不利衝擊，美元仍具一定的承受能力。」
債券遭拋售
周二美國公債殖利率及其他主要債市的拋售進一步加劇，市場對通膨與財政債務的擔憂升溫。美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，2年期公債殖利率也升至2024年7月以來最高。
自聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度經濟政策研討會發表偏鷹的主題演講後，市場對9月升息的預期大幅升溫。
本周市場原本聚焦通膨，但現在貨幣政策觀察人士也將注意力轉向美國勞動市場，希望從最新數據中尋找聯準會未來政策方向的更多線索。
周二公布的最新職位空缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)顯示，美國7月職缺數為727.1萬個，低於市場預期的733萬，但仍高於經下修後的6月718.2萬。
雖然7月職缺數低於預期，但職缺數較6月增加，而且整體水準仍接近4月創下的兩年高點758.5萬，顯示美國就業市場仍具韌性。
這讓聯準會在是否立即收緊貨幣政策方面獲得一些喘息空間，市場利率預期也反映了這點。
根據CME FedWatch工具，JOLTS數據公布後，市場預期聯準會9月升息1碼的機率約為68%，維持利率不變的機率則接近32%，兩者與前一日相比都沒有太大變化。
現在市場焦點已轉向周五公布的美國8月非農就業報告。
歐元走弱 日元連續第三日再度觸及160
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1歐元兌1.1587美元。
歐盟統計局(Eurostat)稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區8月整體消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率加速至3.3%，明顯高於7月的2.9%。
不過，排除波動較大的能源、食品、酒類及菸草後的核心CPI，年增率意外從2.5%降至2.4%，服務通膨則放緩至3%。
日元兌美元走弱，美元兌日元上漲0.3%，至160.22。
160日元兌1美元是市場高度關注的關卡，過去曾觸發日本政府干預匯市，包括7月底日本與美國進行的一次歷史性聯合干預行動。
美國財政部長貝森特在G20財長會議期間，公開敦促日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)升息。
貝森特此舉被視為釋放「安倍經濟學」(Abenomics)時代結束的訊號。他並表示，自己掌握了一些市場目前並不知道、與日本穩定匯率措施有關的「資訊」。
換匯市場隨後提高對日本銀行9月升息的預期，目前升息機率接近88%。這項偏鷹的政策預期也推動日本10年期公債殖利率突破3%，創1996年8月以來首次。

items.title: 貝森特當面施壓植田和男！敦促日本採穩健政策 避免匯率劇烈波動
items.title_en: Bessent Presses Ito Kazuya in Person! Urges Japan to Adopt Prudent Policy to Avoid Sharp Currency Fluctuations
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(9/1)與日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男會面，呼籲日本採取穩健貨幣政策，避免匯率劇烈波動。與此同時，川普政府正推動20國集團(G20)共同解決全球貿易與財政失衡，並將矛頭指向中國出口導向的經濟模式。
全球債市周二再掀賣壓，日本10年期公債殖利率自1996年以來首度觸及3%。美國、日本、歐元區、德國及英國公債殖利率全面攀升，反映能源價格推升通膨、主要央行可能收緊政策，以及各國財政狀況惡化等疑慮。

貝森特會晤植田和男 全球債市再掀賣壓

英國債市周一因國定假日休市後補跌，公債殖利率周二急升10個基點。中東再度爆發攻擊事件，也加深市場對能源供應及通膨壓力的擔憂。
貝森特日前接受《路透》訪問時表示，他將敦促G20成員重新檢視與中國的貿易條件，並考慮提高中國商品的貿易壁壘，迫使北京降低對出口的依賴，轉向提振國內消費。
美國已對中國商品課徵高額關稅，並禁止進口中國汽車等部分產品。由於中國內需長期疲弱，北京持續擴大電動車、半導體及其他商品出口，7月出口額年增23.9%，也促使歐盟要求加強限制中國進口商品的聲浪升高。
不過，美國能否讓立場分歧的G20成員就全球失衡問題達成聯合公報，仍存在高度不確定性。中國長期不願接受削減產業補貼及調整經濟結構的要求，人民幣依多項衡量標準仍明顯遭到低估。
美國自身也尚未提出降低龐大財政赤字的具體方案。經濟學家認為，若要縮減每年超過1兆美元的全球貿易逆差，華府同樣必須處理過度支出的問題。

中國出口與補貼成焦點 G20聯合公報陷僵局

歐盟執委會經濟事務執委杜姆布羅夫斯基斯(Valdis Dombrovskis)表示，中國確實是全球經濟失衡的主要來源，但美國與歐洲也必須採取行動。他將解方概括為「中國增加消費、美國減少支出、歐盟增加投資」。
中國去年對歐盟商品貿易順差達3,606億歐元，較2024年增加15%，今年更因中國企業對歐出口增加、進口減少而持續擴大。
波蘭財政部長Andrzej Domanski支持美方立場，認為中國對貿易夥伴的龐大順差已成為重大問題。他指出，人民幣遭到嚴重低估，中國也積極補貼出口，歐盟已採取行動，包括對多數來自中國的電商小包裹課徵關稅。
關鍵礦產出口限制也是會議爭議焦點。中國2025年4月為反制川普關稅，對稀土實施出口管制，並波及非美國企業。日本財務大臣片山皋月表示，她已向G20成員強調，任意限制關鍵礦產出口正在傷害全球經濟，相關措施應予撤銷。
知情官員透露，聯合公報中有關全球失衡的內容最難取得共識，中國反對點名「非市場經濟體」，也不接受以強硬措辭批評關鍵礦產供應限制。歐洲國家則要求納入批評俄羅斯侵略烏克蘭的文字。
俄羅斯財政部長西盧安諾夫(Anton Siluanov)周一親自出席會議，是俄國2022年入侵烏克蘭後首度派財長到場，令許多歐洲官員感到意外與不滿，進一步增加G20達成共識的難度。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Bank of Japan Governor Kazuya Ito on Tuesday (9/1) and urged Japan to adopt a prudent monetary policy to avoid sharp currency fluctuations. Meanwhile, the Trump administration is pushing the G20 to jointly address global trade and fiscal imbalances and is pointing the finger at China’s export‑oriented economic model.

Global bond markets saw another sell‑off on Tuesday, with the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hitting 3% for the first time since 1996. Yields on U.S., Japanese, euro‑area, German and British bonds all rose, reflecting concerns that energy prices are pushing inflation, major central banks may tighten policy, and fiscal conditions in various countries are deteriorating.

Bessent meets Ito as global bond markets see another sell‑off. The U.K. bond market fell after a holiday on Monday, and Treasury yields jumped 10 basis points on Tuesday. A new attack in the Middle East further deepened market worries about energy supply and inflationary pressure.

In a recent interview with Reuters, Bessent said he would urge G20 members to re‑examine trade terms with China and consider raising trade barriers on Chinese goods, forcing Beijing to reduce its reliance on exports and shift to boosting domestic consumption.

The U.S. has imposed high tariffs on Chinese goods and banned imports of certain Chinese products such as cars. Because domestic demand in China has long been weak, Beijing continues to expand exports of electric vehicles, semiconductors and other goods, with July exports up 23.9% year‑on‑year, also prompting the EU to raise calls for stronger restrictions on Chinese imports.

However, it remains highly uncertain whether the U.S. can get G20 members with divergent positions to agree on a joint statement on global imbalances. China has long been unwilling to accept cuts to industrial subsidies and adjustments to its economic structure, and the renminbi remains clearly undervalued by multiple measures.

The U.S. itself has yet to propose a concrete plan to reduce its massive fiscal deficit. Economists say that to shrink the global trade deficit of over $1 trillion a year, Washington must also address its own excessive spending.

China’s exports and subsidies are the focus as the G20 joint statement stalls. EU Executive Vice‑President for Economic Affairs Valdis Dombrovskis said China is indeed a major source of global economic imbalance, but the U.S. and Europe must also act. He summed up the solution as “China increases consumption, the U.S. cuts spending, the EU increases investment.”

Last year China had a trade surplus of €360.6 billion with the EU, 15% higher than in 2024, and this year it has continued to expand due to Chinese firms increasing exports to the EU and reducing imports.

Polish Finance Minister Andrzej Domanski supports the U.S. position, saying China’s large trade surpluses with partners have become a major problem. He pointed out that the renminbi is severely undervalued and that China actively subsidizes exports, and that the EU has taken action, including imposing tariffs on most Chinese e‑commerce parcels.

Restrictions on key mineral exports were also a point of contention at the meeting. In April 2025, China imposed export controls on rare earths in retaliation for Trump tariffs, affecting non‑U.S. firms. Japanese Finance Minister Shigeki Katayama said she had urged G20 members that arbitrary restrictions on key mineral exports are harming the global economy and that such measures should be revoked.

According to insiders, the most difficult part of the joint statement on global imbalances was reaching consensus. China opposed naming “non‑market economies” and did not accept harsh language criticizing key mineral supply restrictions. European countries demanded that criticism of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine be included.

Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov attended the meeting on Monday, marking the first time a Russian finance minister has been present since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine. His presence surprised and upset many European officials, further increasing the difficulty of reaching G20 consensus.

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣承壓 台股漲逾800點帶動台幣獨強收31.633元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Holds Under Pressure as Stock Market Gains Over 800 Points, Driving the Dollar Strong at 31.633
paras: 中東緊張局勢再起，加上聯準會偏鷹態度，持續為美元提供支撐，亞幣今(1)日普遍承壓，但台北股匯上演雙漲走勢，大盤勁揚逾 800 點，新台幣兌美元也翻升，終場收在 31.633 元，升值 3.3 分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值 26.17 億美元。
台股今天大漲820.25點，收在46948.72點，創近2個月收盤新高。三大法人同步買超，共計561.38億元，其中外資買超約267億元。
新台幣兌美元匯率今天以31.64元開盤，在熱錢回流下，一度升破 31.6 元關卡，觸及31.59元，但午後美元買盤逐步出籠，使匯價升幅收斂，收31.633元，升3.3分。
主要貨幣今天表現方面，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲0.12%，亞幣普遍承壓，韓元貶值0.33%最重，日元亦貶值0.26%，人民幣小貶0.04%，新台幣則逆勢升值 0.1%。
聯準會主席華許上周五表示，如果決策官員無法獲得足夠信心，確信通膨正朝2%的目標下降，那麼聯準會「還有工作要做」。暗示 Fed 可能需要進一步緊縮貨幣政策，以抑制價格上漲壓力。這番談話推升了市場對9月升息的押注。市場目前預期聯準會下個月採取升息行動的機率升至60%。
paras_en: Middle East tensions flare again, and the Fed’s hawkish stance continues to support the dollar, putting pressure on Asian currencies today. Yet Taipei’s stock and currency markets saw a double rise: the market surged over 800 points, and the New Taiwan dollar against the U.S. dollar climbed, closing at 31.633, a 3.3‑cent appreciation, with total trading volume in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai forex markets reaching $2.617 billion.

Taiwan’s stock market jumped 820.25 points today, closing at 46,948.72, marking a new two‑month closing high. The three major institutional investors all bought in, with a net inflow of 56.138 billion NTD, of which foreign investors contributed about 26.7 billion NTD.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.64 per U.S. dollar. With hot money flowing back, it briefly broke the 31.6 barrier, touching 31.59, but in the afternoon U.S. dollar buying gradually eased, narrowing the upside and closing at 31.633, a rise of 3.3 cents.

In terms of major currencies, the Fed’s statistics show the dollar index rose 0.12%, Asian currencies generally weakened, the Korean won fell 0.33% most sharply, the yen fell 0.26%, the renminbi fell 0.04%, while the New Taiwan dollar ran counter‑to‑trend and appreciated 0.1%.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell said last Friday that if policymakers lack sufficient confidence that inflation is moving toward the 2% goal, the Fed still has work to do. He hinted that the Fed may need to tighten policy further to curb price pressures, boosting market bets on a September rate hike. Market expectations for a Fed rate increase next month have risen to 60%.

items.title: 日本10年債殖利率衝3%創30年新高！日元疲弱加劇日銀升息壓力
items.title_en: Japan 10-Year Bond Yield Surges to 3%, a 30-Year High! Weak Yen Heightens BOJ Rate‑Hike Pressure
paras: 日本10年期公債殖利率周二(1日)升抵3%，為1996年以來新高，這是日本基準借貸成本多年來徘徊於近零水準後，逐步回歸正常化的重要里程碑，也凸顯通膨、財政疑慮與貨幣政策轉向，正重塑這個長期以低利率聞名的市場。
日本10年期公債殖利率周二一度上升6個基點至3%，約一年前，殖利率僅為目前水準的一半，凸顯這波變化速度之快，其影響正擴及日本經濟與全球金融市場。
在中東危機加劇全球通膨憂慮的情況下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)正面臨加速升息的壓力，導致日本公債各年期殖利率近期紛紛升抵歷史高檔。不只日本10年期公債殖利率快速上升，短天期方面，5年期殖利率升至歷史新高，2年期殖利率則攀抵31年高點，反映市場幾乎篤定日銀將在本月會議升息。
日本公債遭拋售受到市場高度關注，原因是日本龐大的債務負擔，使其特別容易受到借貸成本上升衝擊。日本10年期公債8月標售需求已降至一年來最疲弱水準。
日本首相高市早苗自去年10月上任以來，一直推動以投資帶動成長的經濟路線，鎖定戰略性產業擴大投資。不過，這些支出加上規劃中的減稅措施，讓市場擔憂日本財政狀況可能進一步惡化。目前日本政府債務規模已超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的200%。
日本並非唯一面臨債市壓力的國家，由於美伊衝突持續升溫，油價居高不下，市場提高對通膨與主要央行進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期，近來美國、德國與法國公債殖利率也紛紛升至多年高點。
據傳高市政府支持日銀近期升息，以支撐持續疲弱的日元，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也加強對日銀的壓力，要求推進下一步貨幣政策正常化。
paras_en: Japan's 10‑year government bond yield rose to 3% on Tuesday (the 1st), marking a new high since 1996. This milestone signals the gradual normalization of Japan's benchmark borrowing cost after years of hovering near zero, and highlights how inflation, fiscal concerns, and a shift in monetary policy are reshaping a market long known for low rates.

The 10‑year yield briefly jumped six basis points to 3% on Tuesday, a level that was only about half of what it was roughly a year ago, underscoring the rapid pace of this change and its expanding impact on both the Japanese economy and global financial markets.

Amid an escalating Middle‑East crisis that is stoking global inflation worries, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is under mounting pressure to accelerate rate hikes, pushing yields across Japanese government bonds to historic highs. Not only has the 10‑year yield surged, but the 5‑year yield has reached a fresh record and the 2‑year yield has climbed to a 31‑year peak, reflecting a market almost certain that the BOJ will raise rates at this month’s meeting.

The sell‑off in Japanese bonds is drawing close market scrutiny because Japan’s massive debt load makes it especially vulnerable to higher borrowing costs. Demand for the August auction of 10‑year bonds has already fallen to the weakest level in a year.

Prime Minister Kishida since taking office in October last year has pursued an investment‑driven growth strategy, targeting strategic industries for expanded spending. However, these outlays combined with planned tax cuts have raised market fears that Japan’s fiscal situation could deteriorate further. Government debt now exceeds 200% of GDP.

Japan is not alone in facing bond‑market pressure. With the US‑Iran conflict heating up and oil prices staying high, markets have raised expectations of inflation and further tightening by major central banks, causing yields on U.S., German and French government bonds to climb to multi‑year highs.

Reports suggest the Kishida administration is backing a recent BOJ rate hike to support the persistently weak yen, while U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent has stepped up pressure on the BOJ to advance the next stage of monetary‑policy normalization.

items.title_en: Downplaying US Rate‑Hike Pressure! Japan Finance Minister: Confirmed with US Counterpart to Continue Coordinated FX Action
paras: 日本財務大臣片山皋月週一(8月31日)表示，她與美國財長貝森特一致認為，兩國近期聯手干預匯市帶來正面效果，但她同時淡化有關貝森特一直敦促日本央行(BOJ)升息的報導。
人在美國北卡羅來納州參加G20財長及央行總裁會議的她說：「貝森特部長和我確認，日元有序波動對維持包括美國市場在內的全球金融市場穩定至關重要，而日美財長共同行動，將有助於實現這一共同目標。」
儘管美日兩國7月底極為罕見地聯手干預匯市，但日元仍面臨新的下行壓力。聯準會(Fed)主席華許上週五發表演說釋放出偏鷹訊號後，日元應聲跌至一個月新低，觸及美日聯手干預以來的最低價位。
日元走弱，加上貝森特近期接連發表暗示日本有必要升息的言論，令市場揣測BOJ可能在9月會議上決定緊縮。
《NHK》週一稍早引述美國財政部負責國際事務的副部長Erin Browne的話報導指出，貝森特在不同的會議上告訴片山和BOJ總裁植田和男，日本下一步行動應該提高利率。
貝森特週一表示，他預計日本政府和日本央行將採取措施推動日元走強，而這一表態暗示BOJ升息的可能性較高。「我掌握一些市場並不知道的資訊，我相信日本政府和BOJ將採取措施，推動日元走強。」
當被問及這是否意味著BOJ將升息時，貝森特答道：「我認為市場現在已經開始消化這一預期。」
貝森特發表上述言論後，日元兌美元走強，進一步強化了市場認為BOJ將在9月會議上升息的預期。
消息人士表示，BOJ最快可能在9月17日至18日舉行的政策會議上升息，且正考慮以快於當前每年大約升息兩次節奏進一步緊縮貨幣政策。
貝森特多次呼籲BOJ升息，已成為推動市場幾乎完全計入9月升息預期的因素之一。BOJ最近一次升息是在今年6月，當時將政策利率上調至1%，創31年來新高。
一些分析師表示，如果BOJ選擇在9月升息而非10月，可能進一步強化市場關於未來每季升息一次的押注。
paras_en: Japan Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama said on Monday (August 31) that she and US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen both believe the recent joint intervention in the foreign‑exchange market has had a positive effect, while she downplayed reports that Yellen has been continuously urging the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates.

Speaking in North Carolina at the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting, she said: "Secretary Yellen and I agreed that an orderly movement of the yen is essential for maintaining stability in global financial markets, including the United States, and that joint US‑Japan actions will help achieve this shared goal."

Even though the United States and Japan carried out a rare joint intervention at the end of July, the yen still faces fresh downward pressure. After Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell delivered a hawkish speech last Friday, the yen fell to a one‑month low, hitting the lowest level since the US‑Japan intervention.
The yen’s weakness, combined with Yellen’s recent remarks suggesting Japan needs to raise rates, has led the market to speculate that the BOJ may decide to tighten at its September meeting.

NHK earlier on Monday quoted Erin Browne, the U.S. Treasury’s deputy assistant secretary for international affairs, reporting that Yellen told Katayama and BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at separate meetings that Japan’s next step should be to raise interest rates.

Yellen said on Monday that she expects the Japanese government and the BOJ to take steps to strengthen the yen, a statement that implies a higher likelihood of a BOJ rate hike. "I have information that the market does not yet know, and I am confident the Japanese government and the BOJ will act to push the yen higher," she said.
When asked whether this meant the BOJ would raise rates, Yellen replied, "I think the market is already beginning to digest that expectation."
After Yellen’s comments, the yen appreciated against the dollar, further reinforcing market expectations that the BOJ will raise rates at its September meeting.
Sources say the BOJ could raise rates as early as its policy meeting on September 17‑18 and is considering tightening at a pace faster than the current roughly twice‑a‑year rhythm.

Yellen’s repeated calls for a BOJ rate hike have become one of the factors that have led the market to almost fully price in a September hike. The BOJ last raised rates in June, moving the policy rate to 1%, a 31‑year high.
Some analysts note that if the BOJ chooses to hike in September rather than October, it could further strengthen market bets on a quarterly rate‑hike pattern going forward.

隨著日經新聞報導，日本各省廳為2027財政年預算申請的支出總額約143兆日圓，有望創下初始預算申請規模紀錄新高，並據數據顯示達拉斯聯邦儲備銀行8月製造業指數升至11.6，但美國財政部長貝森特向消費者新聞與商業頻道(CNBC)表示相信日本政府和日本央行(BOJ)將採取行動推動日圓走強，增添BOJ本月政策會議上加息的可能性，打壓美元兌日圓至159.45低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於159.30-50，阻力於160.10-30。

◆GBP/USD
FED主席沃什的鷹派言論，影響市場對FED於9月加息的概率躍升至57%，提供美元支撐，而且美國與伊朗的緊張局勢升級，削弱投資人的風險偏好，週一打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3517低點。隨著美國7月新增就業崗位意外下降，市場開始為本周將公布的美國就業數據做準備，適逢英國假期休市交易較清淡，扶助英鎊兌美元回升至1.3565高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3550-70，支撐於1.3460-80。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell said at the Jackson Hole symposium that if policymakers are not convinced inflation is moving back toward the 2% target, the Fed still has work to do. This was the closest the Fed has come to acknowledging a possible rate hike. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees a 57.5% chance of at least a 25‑basis‑point increase at the September meeting. Over the weekend the U.S. military struck Iran’s Larak Island – the first U.S. attack on Iran since late July – and President Trump warned he would pulverise the Iranian energy hub of Khark Island, prompting Iranian retaliation, spiking oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields. Treasury Secretary Yellen said the yen’s recent move is largely under control, implying a new round of yen weakness is not expected despite the disorderly swings that led to a rare joint U.S.–Japan intervention last month. The dollar rose to a 160.20 high against the yen on Monday, but July Japanese data showed industrial output rose 0.1% month‑on‑month and 4.2% year‑on‑year, while retail sales were up 4.0% YoY, providing support for the yen.

According to Nikkei reports, Japan’s ministries are requesting a FY2027 budget of about ¥143 trillion, potentially a record‑high initial request. Dallas Fed manufacturing PMI rose to 11.6 in August. Treasury Secretary Yellen told CNBC she believes the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan will act to strengthen the yen, adding to the odds of a BOJ rate hike at this month’s policy meeting and pushing USD/JPY down to a 159.45 low. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to find support around 159.30‑159.50 and face resistance near 160.10‑160.30 today.
EUR/USD

The market broadly expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to raise rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday, though there is considerable uncertainty about the peak level of rates. The NZD was modestly boosted yesterday, but a new round of U.S.–Iran clashes lifted oil prices and heightened inflation concerns. ANZ’s survey shows New Zealand’s August business outlook index fell to 53.7 and the activity index to 48.2. In Australia, Q2 corporate inventories unexpectedly fell 0.2%, which could trim GDP growth by 0.3% and weigh on the AUD, dragging the EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1573.

Data from the German Institute for Economic Research (IW), obtained by Reuters, show that a surge in UK investment helped Germany’s foreign direct investment grow 50% year‑on‑year last year, fully offsetting a sharp drop in U.S. corporate investment. The Iran conflict pushed energy prices higher, and Germany’s August CPI and HICP both rose 2.9% YoY, below expectations. The easing of war‑related price pressure could spread further in the economy, lifting the euro to a high of 1.1620. Today’s EUR/USD resistance is projected at 1.1620‑1.1640 with support at 1.1540‑1.1560.
GBP/USD

Powell’s hawkish comments lifted the market’s view of a September Fed hike to a 57% probability, supporting the dollar, while escalating U.S.–Iran tensions reduced investors’ risk appetite, pushing GBP/USD down to a low of 1.3517 on Monday. With July U.S. job additions unexpectedly falling, markets are gearing up for this week’s U.S. employment data. A quiet UK holiday session helped the pound recover to a high of 1.3565. Today’s GBP/USD resistance is around 1.3550‑1.3570 and support near 1.3460‑1.3480.

items.title: 新興股市創22年來最強8月漲幅！「美元貶值交易」是主要推手 9月面臨Fed升息大考
items.title_en: Emerging Markets Record Strongest August Gains in 22 Years, Driven by "Dollar-Debasement Trade"; September Faces Fed Rate Hike Test
paras: 新興市場股市8月創下2004年以來最大單月漲幅，主因是人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮從大型科技股擴散，加上原物料上漲，帶動資金持續流入開發中國家市場，幫助抵禦了北半球夏季假期期間常見的市場波動。
MSCI新興市場股票指數8月共上漲3.2%，全球投資人尋求分散美元計價資產配置是主因，而這股資金轉向同時也推升黃金需求，現貨金價8月共計大漲了9.7%。
Tellimer新興市場股票與地緣政治策略主管Malik表示，市場押注「美元貶值交易」(dollar-debasement trade)，是支撐新興市場股市上漲的重要力量。美元貶值交易指的是，美國政府可能容許美元購買力逐步下滑，以減輕龐大債務與財政赤字負擔。
Malik說：「美國財政與債務疑慮引發新一輪資金流入新興市場貨幣資產，包括股票。AI科技指標股的市場情緒也趨於穩定，而美元貶值交易則推升黃金價格。」
新興市場股市周一一度面臨壓力。MSCI新興市場股票指數當天下跌0.2%，但已脫離盤中最大1.4%的跌幅，主要是因為中東衝突惡化，以及市場提高聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周五在傑克森洞(Jackson Hole)的演說持續發酵，交易員已把9月升息1碼的機率提高至60%以上。
亞洲方面，南韓股市在三星證券指出退休基金進場買進科技股後反彈，由於SK海力士與三星電子周一都上漲上漲至少1.2%，讓MSCI新興市場指數得以收復部分盤中失地。

9月風險事件密集 

隨著時序進入9月，市場將面臨一連串重大事件，包括本周五(9月4日)公布的美國8月非農就業報告，以及9月11日公布的通膨數據，和9月16日Fed利率決策。
若Fed升息，可能削弱「美元貶值交易」的影響力，透過推升美元與美國公債殖利率，進而削弱風險性資產的投資吸引力。

新興市場貨幣連兩月走強

外匯市場方面，新興市場貨幣指數8月是連續第二個月上漲。南韓韓元與南非蘭德是本月表現最佳的新興市場貨幣。
Avenue首席策略師兼合夥人William Castro Alves表示：「投資人尋找美元與美國資產替代選項，正為其他投資標的提供支撐。整體而言，新興市場展望依然正面。」
paras_en: Emerging market equities posted their biggest monthly gain in August since 2004, driven by the AI investment boom spilling over from large‑cap tech stocks and rising commodity prices, which kept capital flowing into developing‑country markets and helped offset the typical volatility during the Northern Hemisphere summer holidays.

The MSCI Emerging Markets Index rose 3.2% in August, as global investors sought to diversify away from dollar‑denominated assets. That shift also boosted gold demand, with spot gold jumping 9.7% over the month.

Tellimer’s emerging‑markets and geopolitical strategy head Malik said the market is betting on a "dollar‑debasement trade," which has been a key driver of the rally in emerging‑market equities. The dollar‑debasement trade refers to the possibility that the U.S. government may allow the dollar’s purchasing power to gradually decline to ease its massive debt and fiscal‑deficit burdens.

Malik added: "Concerns over U.S. fiscal health and debt are prompting a new wave of capital into emerging‑market currency assets, including equities. Sentiment around AI‑related stocks is also stabilising, while the dollar‑debasement trade is lifting gold prices."

Emerging‑market equities faced pressure on Monday, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index slipping 0.2% that day, though it recovered from an intraday low of 1.4% after the worsening Middle‑East conflict and heightened expectations of a Fed rate hike in September.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s remarks at Jackson Hole last Friday continued to reverberate, and traders have raised the probability of a one‑point rate hike in September to over 60%.

In Asia, South Korean markets rebounded after Samsung Securities noted that pension funds were buying tech stocks; both SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics rose at least 1.2% on Monday, helping the MSCI Emerging Markets Index recoup some of its intraday losses.

September risk calendar: As the calendar moves into September, markets will face a string of major events, including the U.S. August non‑farm payrolls report on Friday (Sept. 4), inflation data on Sept. 11, and the Fed’s rate decision on Sept. 16.
If the Fed raises rates, it could weaken the impact of the dollar‑debasement trade by pushing up the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields, thereby reducing the appeal of risk assets.

Emerging‑market currencies have strengthened for two consecutive months. In the FX market, the emerging‑market currency index rose for the second month in a row in August, with the South Korean won and South African rand posting the best performances among emerging currencies that month.

William Castro Alves, chief strategist and partner at Avenue, said: "Investors are seeking alternatives to the dollar and U.S. assets, which is providing support to other investment targets. Overall, the outlook for emerging markets remains positive."

items.title: EUR/USD：歐元守在1.16美元附近，美國就業報告將成為本週主要考驗
items.title_en: EUR/USD: Euro Holds Near $1.16, U.S. Jobs Report to Be This Week’s Main Test
paras: 要點：

歐元跌破1.16美元
就業數據將撼動外匯市場
Warsh在傑克遜霍爾釋出謹慎訊號


Warsh在傑克遜霍爾發表偏鷹派談話，重新提振美元。如今，週五公布的非農就業數據將決定這項升息警告是否有經濟數據作為支撐。

歐元迎戰重新強勢的美元


週一，eurusd在1.16美元附近交易，此前美元從上週約1.18美元的位置走強，升至兩週高點附近。
歐元仍有望連續第二個月上漲，但在聯準會主席Kevin Warsh提醒市場美國利率可能需要再次上調後，歐元的上漲動能有所減弱。
Warsh 在傑克遜霍爾表示，除非通膨明確朝聯準會2%的目標靠攏，否則可能需要進一步緊縮。如今，交易員認為9月升息的機率約為57%，大幅高於他發表談話前約35%的水準。
美國2年期國債殖利率升向4.33%，提高美元資產可提供的報酬率。這項殖利率優勢是歐元目前面臨的主要問題：歐元即使有改善中的經濟數據，也必須與一種其央行再次暗示將提高投資人報酬率的貨幣競爭。


週五就業報告將成為關鍵決定因素


8月非農就業數據將於週五美東時間上午8:30公布，經濟學家預期新增約50,000個就業職位，失業率維持在約4.1%。此前7月就業人數意外減少23,000。
如果就業報告表現強勁 — 尤其是非農就業、薪資與工時數據均穩健 — 將支持Warsh的立場，並可能推動歐元進一步跌破1.16美元。
如果就業數據再次疲弱，則可能挑戰市場對9月升息的預期，壓低美國國債殖利率，並為EUR/USD重返近期高點提供更順暢的空間。
交易員應先關注相關的輔助數據。美國 職缺數據將於週二公布，此外，私人部門就業指標、失業救濟金申請人數以及修正後的生產力數據，也將在本週稍後提供更多線索。


歐洲也將公布自己的通膨數據


歐元區通膨數據將於週二公布，整體通膨率可能加速至3.3%附近。較高的通膨將強化市場對歐洲央行9月升息的預期，可能抵銷部分因Warsh言論而獲得支撐的美元漲勢。
最終版製造業與服務業PMI將檢驗歐洲近期的經濟改善是否具有持續性。8月初值調查顯示，受製造業訂單增加與出口重新成長帶動，歐元區企業活動以今年最快的速度擴張。
從技術面來看，1.1600美元是近期關鍵樞軸位，其下方支撐位依序約為1.1550與1.1500美元。上方阻力則位於1.1660 –1.1700美元附近。
如果美國就業報告疲弱、同時歐元區通膨維持強勁，可能迫使EUR/USD向上突破；如果非農就業強勁，則歐元多頭將不得不同時面對聯準會與債券市場的雙重壓力。

paras_en: Warsh’s hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole forum have revived the dollar, and the non‑farm payroll data released Friday will determine whether this rate‑hike warning is backed by economic evidence.

On Monday, the EUR/USD traded around $1.16 after the dollar strengthened from about $1.18 last week to near a two‑week high. The euro could still rise for a second consecutive month, but its momentum weakened after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned that U.S. rates may need to rise again. Warsh said at Jackson Hole that further tightening may be required unless inflation clearly moves toward the Fed’s 2% target. Traders now see about a 57% chance of a September rate hike, up sharply from the roughly 35% level before his speech. The U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.33%, boosting the return on dollar assets. This yield advantage is the euro’s main challenge: even with improving economic data, the euro must compete with a currency whose central bank has again hinted at higher investor returns.

The non‑farm payroll data for August will be released Friday at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. Economists expect about 50,000 new jobs and an unemployment rate near 4.1%, after July’s unexpected decline of 23,000 jobs. If the jobs report is strong—especially if non‑farm employment, wages, and hours all show solid growth—it will support Warsh’s stance and could push the euro further below $1.16. If the data are weak, it could challenge the market’s September hike expectations, lower U.S. Treasury yields, and provide smoother room for the EUR/USD to return to recent highs. Traders should first focus on related auxiliary data: U.S. job openings will be released on Tuesday, along with private‑sector employment indicators, unemployment‑benefit claims, and revised productivity figures that will offer more clues later this week.
